works.title: Oh, Mister Leader, Please Play a Tango for Me
works.sortTitle: Oh, Mister Leader, Please Play a Tango for Me
works.publicNote: English-language version registered in London in 1932, with Fritz Rotter’s German words and music by Kaper and “German” (Fritz German, i.e. Hermann Scheibenhofer), the credits of “Du lieber Geiger, spiel einen Tango für mich”.

works.title: Falling in Love with You
works.publicNote: English waltz registered in London in 1932 with music by “Bob Handers”, which the same volume’s index resolves as a joint pseudonym of Walter Jurmann and Bronisław Kaper; the original German words are by Fritz Rotter.
